column1: # mapping_set_description: Property correspondences from DDI Codebook 2.5 XML to CDIF, as applied by the DDI 2.5 converters (DDI/ddi_to_cdif.py, Harvard Dataverse; and DDICodebook/ddi25_to_cdif.py, source-agnostic, which adds aggregate-cube, code-list and quality mappings).
#   Structural transforms the converter performs that are not term-to-term
#   mappings (so they have no TSV row):

#   - ddi: subject ids are a minted CURIE convention: XPath-style DDI Codebook 2.5 element paths (element namespace ddi:codebook:2_5); @name / @intrvl denote XML attributes; code-list / quality items are named bare where DDI 2.5 has no single containing path.

#   - A CDIF catalog record is ADDED; dcterms:conformsTo is derived from content by detect_conformance - variables yield data_description, cubes yield data_structure, code lists yield codelist/conceptscheme, quality yields DQV/provenance.

#   - The aggregate-cube, code-list, and quality rows are implemented by the source-agnostic DDICodebook/ddi25_to_cdif.py; DDI/ddi_to_cdif.py covers the study/variable/file subset. See DDICodebook/ddi25-additions-cdif-mapping.md.
